district.description: A picturesque district nestled in the Western Ghats, famous for its sprawling cardamom and tea plantations, the Vaigai Dam, and lush mountain retreats.

culturalEntries.title: Meghamalai - High Wavy Mountains
culturalEntries.shortDescription: A pristine and relatively unexplored hill range in the Western Ghats, known for its extensive tea estates, rich wildlife, and cloud-covered peaks.
culturalEntries.fullDescription: Meghamalai, popularly called the 'High Wavy Mountains', is a cool and misty mountain range situated at an elevation of 1,500 meters. Covered in undulating tea, coffee, and cardamom estates, the region is a crucial biodiversity hotspot forming the Meghamalai Wildlife Sanctuary. It serves as a vital corridor for elephants and the endangered Grizzled Giant Squirrel. Untouched by heavy commercial tourism, it remains one of Tamil Nadu's best-kept secrets for ecological and nature-based exploration.
culturalEntries.historyOrigin: Historically inhabited by indigenous tribes and later developed into tea estates by the British.
culturalEntries.culturalSignificance: Represents a crucial ecological buffer zone in the Western Ghats, preserving the delicate balance between sustainable plantation agriculture and wildlife conservation.
culturalEntries.sourceReferences: State Archaeological and Historical Documentation; Tamil Nadu Tourism

chatbotKnowledge.answerEn: Meghamalai, also known as the High Wavy Mountains, is a serene and relatively unexplored hill station in Theni district. It is famous for its misty tea estates, cardamom plantations, and rich wildlife sanctuary.
chatbotKnowledge.answerTa: தேனி மாவட்டத்தில் உள்ள மேகமலை 'High Wavy Mountains' என்று அழைக்கப்படுகிறது. இது தேயிலை மற்றும் ஏலக்காய் தோட்டங்களுக்கும், மேகங்கள் தவழும் மலை முகடுகளுக்கும், வனவிலங்கு சரணாலயத்திற்கும் பெயர் பெற்ற அழகிய மலைவாசஸ்தலமாகும்.
